evidence_used: Visible wooden block resting on a flat surface
Silicone gripper embodiment capability to handle rough or interrupted surfaces through friction and viscoelastic interaction

silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper uses friction and viscoelastic compliance, making it well-suited for gripping rough and porous materials like wood. A moderate normal force of 3.5 N is sufficient to lift the object securely without exceeding actuator limits.

comparison_evidence: Object material is wood, which is porous and textured
Gecko adhesion requires smooth, nonporous surfaces
Silicone friction accommodates rough and porous surfaces effectively
recommendation_summary: The silicone gripper is recommended because the target object is made of wood, whose surface roughness and porosity are incompatible with the dry-adhesive requirements of the gecko gripper. The silicone gripper can successfully grasp the wooden block using friction and compliant contact.
